_comment: ngsolve mhd#5 (div(B)=0 via HDiv or a grad-div penalty). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.15. The target field (sin(pi y)cos(pi x), -cos(pi y)sin(pi x)) is divergence-free in closed form (measured 1.6e-16), so everything after that is the discretisation's. Plain VectorH1 order 1 carries ||div B|| = 0.308 -- the claim's O(0.1), and nowhere near the 1e-14 the claim says it should be. HDiv order 3 with div(B)=0 imposed through an L2 multiplier gives 5.3e-8, seven orders lower, and is also more accurate. CORRECTION to the 'tau ~ 1' recommendation: at tau = 1 the divergence falls by only 7.3x while the field error grows 10.2x, so it is a poor trade; divergence keeps falling monotonically with tau and the error keeps growing, saturating around 12x. The claim states only one side of that trade. Mutation: forcing the HDiv branch to order 1 with an L2 order 0 multiplier raises the HDiv divergence and the fixture fails on hdiv_divergence_orders_below_vectorh1.
